researchThesis: Capture the weekly CME Bitcoin Friday Futures premium with a benchmark-matched long IBIT hedge, avoiding Coinbase spot trading friction. BFF and IBIT both reference BRRNY at the Friday 4 PM New York settlement benchmark.

productIdentity.financialSettlementBenchmark: CME CF Bitcoin Reference Rate New York Variant (BRRNY)

preFreezeEvidence.sourceQualification: CME public final-settlement JSON produced recent BFF rows without exposing prices during qualification; BlackRock publishes IBIT closing price, BRRNY benchmark identity, basket Bitcoin amount and 40,000-share basket definition.
preFreezeEvidence.knownCostEvidence: Conservatively reserve $0.60 per BFF side for broker/exchange cost and charge it both at opening and cash settlement even though expiration is not a market close; also reserve 10 BFF ticks adverse entry execution.

schedule.rollRule: Roll on each official CME BFF termination date. Normally Friday; if that Friday is not a business day in both London and the U.S., use the preceding day that is a business day in both, exactly as CME specifies.

positionRule.ibitEntryPrice: official IBIT closing price on 2026-08-21 plus frozen adverse half-spread reserve
positionRule.ibitHolding: hold the initial fractional share count continuously; no weekly ETF rebalancing
positionRule.bffEntry: on each Friday use the official CME final settlement for the next-Friday BFF contract minus 10 minimum ticks in USD/BTC as the hypothetical short execution price
positionRule.bffExpiry: cash-settle the expiring BFF at its official BRRNY-linked final settlement; no discretionary close
positionRule.nextContract: the earliest listed BFF expiry after the current BFF termination date; no discretionary expiry selection; holiday-adjusted termination follows the frozen CME business-day rule

costModel.ibitSponsorFeeAccounting: informational only for observed share-price P&L: the 0.25% sponsor fee is already reflected in IBIT NAV/share prices and must not be deducted a second time

riskModel.futuresEquity: $3000 reserve + cumulative realized BFF PnL + current open-short mark PnL - cumulative reserved BFF fees

cme.source: official CME public final settlement JSON

antiRescueRule: After the 2026-08-21 first scientific settlement is observed, no changes to instrument choice, start date, official-expiry rule, hedge size formula, roll schedule, costs, collateral, shocks, accounting clarifications or pass gates are allowed under Trial 13. Any economic change requires a new trial number.

implementationFreezeRevision.reason: Clarify two implementation details before the first scientific settlement: IBIT sponsor fees are already embedded in observed IBIT share prices and must not be deducted a second time; CME BFF expiries use CME's published preceding-business-day holiday rule rather than an impossible literal-Friday rule on exchange holidays.
